answer: Rate new agents by how their trust flows, not by how many accounts they hold. Picture a river of endorsements: an identity only gains voting weight when established peers outside its own cluster vouch for it, and each vouch puts the voucher's stake at risk. A sybil farm can draw an atlas of fake profiles, but they all drain from one source. When graders see a sudden delta of mutual endorsements inside a closed group, that group's weight is frozen pending human review.
